summary: Geoffrey Hinton, known as the 'godfather of AI', has resigned from Google to speak freely about the dangers of AI, warning that chatbots could soon surpass human intelligence and be exploited by bad actors. He emphasizes the need for urgent safety measures while acknowledging short-term benefits.

claims.text: Geoffrey Hinton, a pioneer in AI, has resigned from Google to warn about the dangers of AI.
claims.evidence_quote: A man widely seen as the godfather of artificial intelligence (AI) has quit his job, warning about the growing dangers from developments in the field.

claims.text: Hinton believes AI chatbots could soon surpass human intelligence.
claims.evidence_quote: Right now, they're not more intelligent than us, as far as I can tell. But I think they soon may be.

claims.text: Hinton is 75 years old and retired from Google.
claims.evidence_quote: I'm 75, so it's time to retire.

claims.text: Hinton's research on neural networks and deep learning paved the way for AI systems like ChatGPT.
claims.evidence_quote: Dr Hinton's pioneering research on neural networks and deep learning has paved the way for current AI systems like ChatGPT.

claims.text: GPT-4 has more general knowledge than a human but is not as good at reasoning.
claims.evidence_quote: Right now, what we're seeing is things like GPT-4 eclipses a person in the amount of general knowledge it has and it eclipses them by a long way. In terms of reasoning, it's not as good, but it does already do simple reasoning.

claims.text: Hinton warned that bad actors like Putin could give robots the ability to create their own sub-goals.
claims.evidence_quote: You can imagine, for example, some bad actor like [Russian President Vladimir] Putin decided to give robots the ability to create their own sub-goals.

claims.text: Digital AI systems can share knowledge instantly, unlike biological systems.
claims.evidence_quote: And all these copies can learn separately but share their knowledge instantly. So it's as if you had 10,000 people and whenever one person learnt something, everybody automatically knew it.

claims.text: Matt Clifford said Hinton's announcement underlines the rate at which AI capabilities are accelerating.
claims.evidence_quote: underlines the rate at which AI capabilities are accelerating

claims.text: An open letter in March, co-signed by Elon Musk and Yoshua Bengio, called for a pause on AI development more advanced than ChatGPT.
claims.evidence_quote: In March, an open letter - co-signed by dozens of people in the AI field, including the tech billionaire Elon Musk - called for a pause on all developments more advanced than the current version of AI chatbot ChatGPT so robust safety measures could be designed and implemented.

claims.text: Hinton thinks AI will deliver more benefits than risks in the short term.
claims.evidence_quote: in the shorter term he thought AI would deliver many more benefits than risks

claims.text: Hinton said a pause on AI development would be difficult due to international competition, as China would get a big lead.
claims.evidence_quote: Even if everybody in the US stopped developing it, China would just get a big lead.

claims.text: Hinton said it is the responsibility of government to ensure AI is developed with thought into how to stop it going rogue.
claims.evidence_quote: it was the responsibility of government to ensure AI was developed "with a lot of thought into how to stop it going rogue".

claims.text: Google's chief scientist Jeff Dean said Google remains committed to a responsible approach to AI.
claims.evidence_quote: We remain committed to a responsible approach to AI. We're continually learning to understand emerging risks while also innovating boldly.

claims.text: AI is used in various applications like video streaming recommendations, recruitment, insurance, and medical diagnosis.
claims.evidence_quote: AI is behind the algorithms that dictate what video-streaming platforms decide you should watch next. It can be used in recruitment to filter job applications, by insurers to calculate premiums, it can diagnose medical conditions (although human doctors still get the final say).

claims.text: Even Google boss Sundar Pichai admitted he did not fully understand everything that its AI chatbot Bard did.
claims.evidence_quote: Even Google boss Sundar Pichai said in a recent interview that even he did not fully understand everything that its AI chatbot, Bard, did.
